archetypes.name: dyn-skill-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Design SKILL prose was compressed around pinned orchestration contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed skills/design/SKILL.md prose for accidental weakening of orchestration contracts. Pay special attention to Step 3 plan-review, Step 5 final-summary, pause/resume, and helper-contract wording that was intentionally compressed. Verify required literals remain load-bearing and that no new ambiguity changes runtime behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-closure-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: The closure baseline was regenerated from compressed skill text.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/skill-closure-baseline.json against the edited skill closure metrics. Confirm the baseline was regenerated canonically, harvested file membership is unchanged, and the recorded design-token shrink is real content reduction rather than dropped required references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
